xui_doc_node_info_t.nodeAttributes: The dedicated nodeAttributes method returns the numerical attributes plus owned font-family and optional language strings.
xui_doc_node_info_t.safeTextAlternative: copyText/readText and copySource/readSource write into scoped Buffer storage.

xui_doc_change_info_t.readonlyOperations: DocumentChangeSet.operations returns a NativeSequence that owns a reference to the change set.

notProjected.pOperations: The raw field stays private. The dedicated operations getter returns the same contiguous POD array.

xui_doc_attributes_t.input: setNodeAttributes uses DocumentNodeAttributes, a counted font family and nullable language. setAttributesColumns remains the compatibility form with an empty font family.

xui_doc_node_attributes_view_t.input: The exact text/byte count of the font family is packed without C-string truncation. Native applies its UTF-8, length and schema limits.

xui_doc_node_desc_t.input: insertNode uses default attributes. insertNodeWithAttributes also packs the separate attributes view and the exact bytes, version and required flag of an optional extension payload. Native admits and copies all inputs in one insertion.

xui_doc_image_desc_t.input: insertImage/updateImage pack all public fields with counted alt text and nullable NUL strings.

xui_doc_source_index_desc_t.input: createSourceIndex packs maxWorkingBytes and projects the optional shouldCancel closure into onCancel and stack-scoped pCancelUser. iReserved is zero.

xui_doc_desc_t.input: Owned constructors pack size and all eight ordinary settings.

notProjected.onAlloc: Custom allocator callback lifetime is C-only.
notProjected.onFree: Must be paired with allocator, outlives all handles.

xui_doc_source_patch_t.input: prepareSource/continueSource and their Bytes variants project parallel start/end/text columns. Each temporary record receives exact sizeof, data pointer and actual byte length; readonly pins retain the original string/bytes backing for the synchronous call. Native copies accepted source text before return.

notProjected.writableOutput: Input-only record projection; no writable language array or raw pointer is exposed.

costs.descriptorPacks: Stack initialization and field assignments; counted inputs are pinned; NUL strings require validation/scans.
costs.owningRoots: One resident control/code lease and real native owner per independent root; share/factories reserve before producer.
costs.POD: Exact native values or stack output-record field copies; no arbitrary pointer projection.
costs.buffers: Scope/pin/length checks; Native Copy performs its documented bytes copy; lengths remain unchanged.
costs.callbacks: Native Owned capture ownership plus checked epoch admission; explicit share acquires a real separate owner.
costs.ownedExports: Text adopts the actual resident-XRT allocation after one UTF-8 scan; bytes adds its ordinary owning value carrier. No payload copy or strlen.
costs.sourcePatchInputs: One zero-initialized O(n) native record array plus column read pins and checked field writes. No text copy or NUL scan in the projection; native source processing retains its own documented copies. Default empty array arguments may allocate ordinary input containers.
costs.queryResults: Search and loss collection build one native result per query. Geometric growth can copy its native backing while unpublished. NativeSequence takes a real reference and reads the final immutable backing directly without an array copy.
costs.nodeAttributes: Native translates the exact POD fields and copies the counted font family to inline storage. Language query copies the font family and optional language within the native result scope. The original document transaction performs its usual validation, allocations and COW.
costs.sourceIndexCancellation: The packed synchronous callback uses a stack thunk context and one closure pin per build. Each native poll enters the checked callback boundary. The native index never retains the closure or its userdata.
